repo_notes.content: PulsePlate is a health and nutrition platform with a FastAPI backend, React web client, and SwiftUI iOS client. Documentation should prioritize architecture boundaries, public API contracts, and operational runbooks.
repo_notes.author: Codex Coordinator

repo_notes.content: Keep the wiki aligned with canonical project policies from AGENTS.md: thin-client rules for frontend/iOS, deterministic quality gates, and guarded API namespace governance.
repo_notes.author: Codex Coordinator

repo_notes.content: Food data is a strategic subsystem. Cover USDA/OFF ingestion, snapshot/update orchestration, canonical food store behavior, restaurant integration contracts, and rollout sequencing tracked in BACKLOG_LEDGER.
repo_notes.author: Codex Coordinator

repo_notes.content: For runtime understanding, emphasize exact ownership: app/ for HTTP/middleware/schemas, core/ for domain logic, providers/ for external adapters, deploy/ for runtime environments, tests/ for policy guards.
repo_notes.author: Codex Coordinator

repo_notes.content: Document both canonical and transitional surfaces explicitly where relevant, but keep public contract guidance stable and non-ambiguous for web/iOS consumers.
repo_notes.author: Codex Coordinator
